 Dewa United defeats PSIM Yogyakarta
 6th November 2026 18:46 GMT+7
 PSIM Yogyakarta football player Marvin Antonio Loria (left) and Dewa United Banten FC football player Muhammad Alfharezzi (right) fell while contesting the ball in the BRI Super League match at Sultan Agung Stadium, Bantul, D.I Yogyakarta, Friday (6/11/2026). Dewa United Banten FC defeated PSIM Yogyakarta with a score of 2-1. ANTARA PHOTO/Andreas Fitri Atmoko/tom. ANTARA FOTO/Pesepak bola PSIM Yogyakarta Marvin Antonio Loria (kiri) dan pesepak bola Dewa United Banten FC Muhammad Alfharezzi (kanan) terjatuh saat berebut bola pada laga BRI Super League di Stadion Sultan Agung, Bantul, D.I Yogyakarta, Jumat (6/11/2026). Dewa United Banten FC mengalahkan PSIM Yogyakarta dengan skor 2-1. ANTARA FOtO/Andreas Fitri Atmoko/tom.
